summary.en: A school roof collapsed in Peshawar, killing dozens of children and a teacher, prompting families to demand justice and authorities to order inspections. Afghan Taliban forces opened fire on Pakistani security forces along the Kurram border, and the Pakistani Army responded with intensive intelligence-led operations that killed an officer and several terrorists in Balochistan. Pakistan suspended trade with Iran at two crossings, citing security and smuggling concerns, while trade between Pakistan and Afghanistan fell 74% to $358 million amid border closures. The conflict recorded 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Et skoletak i Peshawar kollapset, og drepte dusinvis av barn og en lærer, noe som fikk familier til å kreve rettferdighet og myndighetene til å beordre inspeksjoner. Taliban-styrkene i Afghanistan åpnet ild mot pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker langs Kurram-grensen, og den pakistanske hæren svarte med intensive etterretningsledede operasjoner som drepte en offiser og flere terrorister i Balochistan. Pakistan suspendert handel med Iran ved to grenseoverganger, med begrunnelse i sikkerhets‑ og smuglingsbekymringer, mens handelen mellom Pakistan og Afghanistan falt 74 % til 358 millioner dollar på grunn av grenselukking. Konflikten registrerte 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
